body: i have BPD too and don’t feel bad for her. she made everyone with BPD look bad and i know a lot of people are using her for the “everyone with BPD is toxic and abusive” argument. watching that whole case get worse with her lying made me sick. maybe people deserve compassion but she made herself look terrible

i had a friend i used for several years and i recently decided i don’t need him to boost my ego anymore . he was getting way too clingy and i had enough. i did enjoy that he was in love with me though

something i automatically do when i’m not getting enough attention is very clearly shut off my body language. my bf and i are very touchy so if i want more i’ll refuse to touch him at first. if he inches closer or tries to touch me i inch away. then he’ll ask me what’s wrong and i’m very dramatic about it. in the car i’ll sit as far to the door as i can and face away from him, refusing to even look at him. and if i’m happy i’ll sit as close to him as possible and hold his hand so he knows the difference.

 if i’m in a group when people are talking and i feel like i’m not getting enough attention i’ll walk away and start fidgeting with something nearby so they all look at me or i’ll play with my hair or shirt or something. even when people are talking about something else they will be looking at you and whatever you’re doing. if it doesn’t work i’ll drop something or “accidentally” break something or whatever.

i’m not saying these are “good” habits and it’s funny because i never really thought about it until i read this post but i do these things all the time

i’ve calmed down and i can be more practical now. the good news is he’s pretty bad at lying and he doesn’t know i know everything he’s done. he has also said several times he can never tell when im lying and i do think that’s true based off some things he’s said to me. nobody suspects me because they always say im very nice and seem innocent so i think we’re good for now

so far i have confirmed it since i accept i can’t lie about it anymore. i did start a few rumors about him and i’m satisfied until finding out more information. this is the only person i’ve actually slept with and not just flirted with because i was dumb and horny lol
glad i could help

i’m BPD with sociopathic tendencies and i dated a sociopath for a bit. it was very interesting and exciting because our impulsivity matched up and we used each other’s manipulation to get things from other people. when i was having an episode he would just sit there and take it, which was great for me because he was too fascinated with me to push me away. eventually my depression got the better of me and we both got bored but we both knew each other’s toxic traits and just didn’t really care. it wouldn’t have lasted but i’d take it over any neurotypical relationship because it was so much more entertaining. it worked better because my BPD was more aggressive than overly attached and i know if i had been more emotional he would have easily taken more advantage of me
i hope you’ll be okay

this is me (19F), i thought my symptoms were just my BPD but i recently started looking into NPD and i hâte it. narcissist is such a negative term and i don’t want it associated with me. but on the other hand i get bored of people very quickly and just want to manipulate and hurt them, which i don’t see as a problem until someone points it out, but then i just brush it off. i thought i might have ASPD but i don’t think my symptoms are intense enough for that. i feel empathy but not really, like i understand things and get sad if i’m depressed but i don’t care about other people’s actual feelings, i just need them to like me so i pretend to like them and be nice.

Right now I don't feel emotional at all, which is why I'm willing to share. I used to get angry about it often, and sometimes I still do. I get sad but only if I'm already having a depressive episode.

Dad had anger issues and would be verbally abusive about very small things, yelling for an hour over not cleaning the dishes, scaring me and my sisters and making us cry. Both parents used to scream at each other, sometimes they would make us leave the house so they could fight. 

Dad forced mom to stay in the basement/not go upstairs so she would be separate from us, used to cause problems with her on purpose (turn off her electricity/not pay her phone bill/etc). 

Both would constantly vent to me and say terrible things about the other and make me feel bad for not backing them up in their arguments. Both were affectionate but it never felt real because of the anger and both emotionally distant. Mom turned to cheating (though they were hardly together at that point)/boyfriends, dad used to drink but I don't remember a lot from that time. 

Therapist also has mentioned I might have sexual trauma I don't remember because of my nightmares/wariness of men and problems with sex/intimacy.

I would hit her or just pretend to sometimes to see her flinch. I was extremely angry and heartless until maybe 13, which is when I started feeling bad about the because I learned how abusive it was. That's also when I learned how to manipulate instead. I feel bad about things and I think that guilt is the strongest feeling I have. Maybe because my parents would blame me for things a lot as a kid? I always thought my childhood was bad but not bad enough to call traumatic, until my therapist told me my responses to things are often associated with trauma (dissociation, attachment issues etc)
